dou_home3_jo.text: Come in, come in. There is a cuppa ready. Manx cats have no tail. The tale says the cat was last onto Noah's Ark and Noah shut the door.
A swiftlet hardly ever lands. The sky is its sofa. I have seen exactly one on my washing line and I took a photo.
My granddaughter says pipkin is a robin in a waistcoat. The red one is its Sunday best. She is generally right.

then.text: You have had your cuppa. Sit a minute, dear, then off to explore.

else.text: Here, take a cuppa for later. It is still warm. Do not tell the Steam Packet.
